name: Manifest LLM Gateway
summary: Open-source LLM gateway routing agent and app queries to 300+ models from 35+ providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description: Manifest connects API keys, subscriptions and local models to one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with custom routing, full-body logs for successful and failed requests, per-dollar spend tracking with notifications and limits, and fallbacks when a query fails. Self-host it with the Docker image (the first account becomes admin) or use one-click deployments for Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, AWS, GCP and others; a cloud version runs at app.manifest.build.
contains: connects 35+ built-in providers and 300+ models to one OpenAI-compatible endpoint
routes by API key, subscription, local model or custom provider; send "model": "auto"
full-body logs for success and error messages
tracks every dollar with notifications and limits
falls back to other models when a query fails; self-heals bad requests
self-hosted Docker image; first account becomes admin
one-click deploys: Railway, Render, DigitalOcean, AWS, GCP, Fly.io and more
MIT licensed; n8n community node available
